Entries.Text: The FMG Reloader works with Elden Ring only.
Connects to the running game and replaces its text (FMG files) with this editor's copies, so text edits can be tested without restarting. The game must run offline with EAC disabled.
Couldn't open the game process (error {0}). Try running Smithbox as administrator.
Couldn't find the game's text functions ({0}). This game version may not be supported.
The game hasn't loaded its text yet.
Replaced text kept in the game this session: {0} KB. It is freed when the game closes.
Reads the game's language and text files every {0} seconds while this tool is shown.
Connects to the game, or reads its text files again.
Closes the connection to the game and turns Auto Refresh off. Text already sent stays in the game.
Sends the selected FMG, or its whole container, to the game. Unsaved edits are included.
Select an FMG to reload it in the game.
Replaces this FMG in the game with the editor's copy, including unsaved edits.
Replaces every FMG of the selected container that the game holds.

Text already on screen changes when the game looks it up again: reopen the menu, talk to the character again, or pick the item up again.
FMGs edited since the last save, in the containers the game reads.
Sends every modified FMG the game reads.
When connected, a manual save also sends the modified FMGs it writes to the game.
